placement: Build tooling stamps the npm package version into the emitted browser-kernel entry point after TypeScript compilation. Runtime metadata is diagnostic browser mechanism only: it creates no application state, crosses no engine boundary, and does not alter the WASM host architecture. Existing browser smoke infrastructure verifies the production artifact in Chromium and WebKit. The minimal example documents and exercises the observable registry. No protocol, Core source, capability, dependency, renderer, or guardrail changes.

expansions.reason: Verify the production-stamped Limen registry in both existing Playwright engines without creating a new browser harness.
